#!/usr/bin/env bash
# R1264ac D1: a case after `time` is a case; inside "$(…)" its pattern ) must not close the substitution.
os="$(
  time case $1 in
    a) echo a ;;
    *) echo "unsupported, can't continue" >&2 ;;
  esac
)"
sudo() { command sudo -n "$@"; }
printf '%s\n' "$os"
# that's the platform
